input.quote: 9.4 Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form without cause by delivering the written notice specified in Section 29.4. Customer owes only accrued Fees, and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees for the period after termination.
input.rationale: Section 9.4 gives us an unqualified without-cause termination right over the Agreement and any Order Form, and Section 29.4 fixes that notice period at thirty days — matching the preferred 30 days' written notice. We owe only accrued Fees (no early-termination fee or accelerated Fees), and Vendor must refund prepaid Fees for the post-termination period, reinforced by Section 10.2. Vendor has no convenience right anywhere in the document: Sections 9.1–9.3 give it only breach and insolvency triggers, and Section 24.4 blocks termination on our change of control. The preferred position is therefore satisfied in a three-year term (Section 8.1); no redline needed. Section 7.7's late-payment liquidated damages is a payment mechanic rather than an early-termination penalty and is addressed under the payment-terms rule.
